card.learned_from: 《Sita Sings the Blues》（2008）、《蜘蛛侠：平行宇宙》（2018）
card.line: 同一样东西，每个时代用自己的笔再画一遍：毛笔、雕版、显像管、像素，接力的那一下是那支笔自己的动作
card.fit: 技术史、媒介史、时间轴长片里一个时代一段
card.instruments: 古琴、羽管键琴和木鱼、合成器音序、芯片方波
card.sounds_like: 毛笔是一声软的扫，滚筒压过去换成羽管键琴，显像管一声嗡地亮起，像素那段全是方波

eras.look: 11 bristles per stroke, dry hairs drop out after 45% of the stroke, a 3 px wet halo

eras.relay_in: a roller pulls the print across, left to right, 0.75 s
eras.look: solid ink with the block's grain and carved feathers; a red seal

eras.relay_in: the beam scans down over the print, 0.55 s
eras.look: green phosphor vectors, two glows, 4 px scanlines, a dark tube edge

eras.relay_in: the screen coarsens into 20 px blocks, then the blocks become a two-frame sprite (6 fps)
eras.look: navy, a dotted grid, a white sprite with a blue outline; type snapped to a 3 px grid

motion.close: a water drop falls 0.22 s and blooms into blank paper in 1.03 s (outCubic, noisy rim)

study.by: Nina Paley (Rajput-style painting, shadow-puppet narrators, vector musical numbers, Squigglevision)
Bob Persichetti, Peter Ramsey, Rodney Rothman; Sony Pictures Animation
